concept: KMS: key policy as the primary access control for a key
tests: How to restrict a customer managed key to a single IAM role, controlled on the key itself.
expected: A KMS key policy granting only that role kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt. Triggers: "usable only by a specific IAM role", "control this directly on the key".
why_not: A bucket policy governs S3, not the key; a security group — network traffic; an SCP denying all KMS actions also blocks legitimate use.
